stemMd: Which café repaired the greatest proportion of its registered items?

options.label: C
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: North: 42/60=70%; East: 48/80=60%; West: 80/100=80%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 80%.

distractorRationale.a: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 70%, 60%, 80%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.d: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 70%, 60%, 80%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.c: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
